# Result|Owner and DACL SDDL|SID expected in a rejection|Optional ancestor path
allow|O:SYD:P(A;;FA;;;SY)|
allow|O:BAD:P(A;;FA;;;BA)|
allow|O:S-1-5-80-956008885-3418522649-1831038044-1853292631-2271478464D:P(A;;FA;;;S-1-5-80-956008885-3418522649-1831038044-1853292631-2271478464)|
allow|O:S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1000D:P(A;;FA;;;S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1000)|
allow|O:SYD:P(A;OICIIO;GA;;;WD)(A;;FA;;;SY)|
allow|O:SYD:P(A;ID;GR;;;WD)(A;;FA;;;SY)|
deny|O:S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001D:P(A;;FA;;;SY)|S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;GA;;;WD)|S-1-1-0
deny|O:SYD:P(A;OICIID;GW;;;BU)|S-1-5-32-545
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;WD;;;AU)|S-1-5-11
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;WO;;;WD)|S-1-1-0
# SDDL DC is the directory-service right 0x2; FILE_DELETE_CHILD is 0x40.
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;0x40;;;WD)|S-1-1-0
# Issue #12442: effective AppContainer full control and inherited Authenticated
# Users modify grants are unsafe even though Windows commonly supplies them.
deny|O:SYD:P(A;OICIID;0x1f01ff;;;S-1-15-3-1)|S-1-15-3-1
deny|O:SYD:P(A;OICIID;0x1301bf;;;AU)|S-1-5-11
# Issue #12527: a different account can have full control of both profile roots.
deny|O:SYD:P(A;OICIID;0x1f01ff;;;S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001)|S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001
# Issue #12563: DELETE cannot remove a volume/share root, but the same grant
# can replace a non-root ancestor. Never change the actual volume's ACL.
allow|O:SYD:P(A;ID;0x1301bf;;;AU)(A;OICIIO;0x1301bf;;;AU)||C:\
allow|O:SYD:P(A;;SD;;;AU)||D:\
allow|O:SYD:P(A;;SD;;;AU)||\\?\C:\
allow|O:SYD:P(A;;SD;;;AU)||\\server\share\
allow|O:SYD:P(A;;SD;;;AU)||\\?\UNC\server\share\
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;SD;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|C:\Users
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;SD;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|\\?\C:\Users
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;SD;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|\\server\share\cache
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;SD;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|C:
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;0x40;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|C:\
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;WD;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|C:\
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;WO;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|C:\
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;GA;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|C:\
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;GW;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|C:\
deny|O:SYD:P(A;;0x1f01ff;;;AU)|S-1-5-11|C:\
deny|O:S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001D:P(A;;GR;;;AU)|S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001|C:\
